title: LADM LA_Party
description: A party is any person or organisation that plays a role in land administration. LA_Party is the base class; LA_GroupParty (a collection of parties with a shared interest) extends it.

id.description: Globally unique identifier (UUID or URI), OGC API compatible

name.description: Full name of the party (person or organisation)

type.description: LA_PartyType codelist. Recommended scheme: LADM LA_PartyType. Common values: individual, baGroup, nonPersonEntity, anonymousParty.

roles.description: Roles this party plays in land administration (LA_PartyRoleType). Common values: owner, lessee, mortgagor, mortgagee, conveyancer.

extPID.description: External party identifier (e.g. national ID, company registration number, ORC-iD)

contact.description: Contact details for this party (OGC API Records contact pattern)
